facts.fact: INSEED's regulatory-texts page names Loi N°026/PR/2019 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in Chad as the statistics law, which makes INSEED the central body of the national statistical system, and lists the law as dated June 2019.
facts.system: Loi N°026/PR/2019 portant organisation et règlementation des activités statistiques au Tchad

facts.fact: The same page lists three decrees dated July 2019 setting out the attributions, organisation and operation of the National Statistics Council, INSEED and the National Statistics Development Fund, alongside an undated decree on the CSS and CPS.
facts.system: Loi N°026/PR/2019 portant organisation et règlementation des activités statistiques au Tchad

facts.fact: INSEED's national data archive access policy requires users to comply with articles 4 to 10 of Loi N°26/PR/2019 of 11 June 2019 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in Chad, which oblige anyone handling individual data collected by the national statistical system to keep respondents anonymous (the page carries no date of its own; its published date is a retrieval proxy).
facts.system: Loi N°26/PR/2019 du 11 juin 2019 portant organisation et règlementation des activités statistiques au Tchad

systems.system: Archive Nationale des Données du Tchad (ANAD)

note: A decree extending the RGPH-3 census enumeration to 6 August 2026; a census decree, not tied to a statistics law, so no fact.
A joint order setting up local RGPH-3 census commissions under a census decree; it says only that they must respect 'the statistics laws' without naming a law, so no fact.
INSEED home page: indicators, publications and data portals; it states nothing about a statistics law.

facts.fact: A technical adviser to Chad's planning minister, presenting at the 2024 Africa Regional Forum on Sustainable Development, lists Loi 26/PR/2019 of 11 June 2019 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in Chad among the reforms strengthening the national statistical system.
facts.system: Loi 26/PR/2019 portant organisation et reglementation des activites statistiques (2019)
